author: Traditionally Matthew, a tax collector and one of the twelve apostles
authorNote: The Gospels do not name their authors; the names come from early church tradition, which scholars weigh differently.
overview: Matthew tells the life of Jesus, showing him as the promised Messiah and King who fulfils the Hebrew Scriptures. It gathers Jesus' teaching into five great speeches, including the Sermon on the Mount. It ends with the resurrection and Jesus sending his followers to make disciples of all nations.
storyPlace: The first book of the New Testament, linking the Old Testament promises to Jesus.
